correctness.rationale: XOR weights 1 and 4 give exactly the five Cayley directions, and forbidden wedges encode the size-two component cutoff. The even five-coordinate model realizes the direction permutation action; the ten non-neighbors of the origin have distinct two-neighbor signatures, so its stabilizer embeds in S5 and the displayed affine subgroup is full. Independent replay gave 2,142 nonempty faces, 1,065 matches and a full topological ordering of the 9,280 directed covers. It left one 0-cell, five 3-cells and six 4-cells, and verified both the integer Morse differential via signed elimination and its leading −1 determinant. The first five 4-cells fill the 3-skeleton into a simply connected acyclic subcomplex, hence a contractible one. The last cell then yields S⁴. The signed oriented-face Lefschetz test gave +1 for translations, −1 for direction transpositions and agreement with sign on all 1,920 automorphisms. After barycentric subdivision quotient chains over Q are orbit chains and averaging is exact. The only reduced homology of X over Q is therefore a line with no invariants, proving the stated rational acyclicity of the connected quotient.
residual_risks: No integral torsion or equivariant homotopy statement about the quotient. Frozen code was not executed; Python 3.10 or later supports its bit-count calls.
